shortDescription: This module registers the insights client

options.name: display_name
options.description: This option is here to enable registering with a display_name outside of using a configuration file. Some may be used to doing it this way so I left this in as an optional parameter.

options.name: force_reregister
options.description: This option should be set to true if you wish to force a reregister of the insights-client. Note that this will remove the existing machine-id and create a new one. Only use this option if you are okay with creating a new machine-id.

options.name: insights_name
options.description: For now, this is just 'insights-client', but it could change in the future so having it as a variable is just preparing for that

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether to register or unregister insights-client
